objective:
Goal: the article's print and export options are shown. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "On the left hand side of the screen, you should see a link that says “Print/Export”.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, verify it on screen. If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: show the article's print and export options; role=button; text="Tools" | HINTS: container=Page tools
actions.instr: Clicking Tools to open print and export options

actions.intent: whether the article's print and export options is present (in the Page tools navigation)
actions.instr: Checking whether the article print and export options are shown

actions.intent: whether the page main heading is present (in the page main content)
actions.instr: Checking whether the page main heading is present
If-else checkpoint cp_2: condition 'the page you end on has a main heading' matched
Get the main heading and save it as {{landed_on}}.

actions.intent: the main heading text of the article
